sentences.text: The in-force documents define EMI as the equated monthly instalment payable by the borrower towards interest and principal, and they show a different home-loan example with a sanctioned amount of ₹25,00,000, 240 monthly instalments, and EMI ₹21,696.
The superseded KFS said that EPIs at monthly intervals are called EMIs, but that circular was withdrawn and is no longer in force on 2026-11-23.

I cannot work out the monthly EMI for the loan in your question from the cited documents alone, because the in-force evidence does not provide a matching loan-specific rate, amount, and tenor for this case.
